scripts.build:apk: npm run build && powershell -NoProfile -Command "Copy-Item -Path 'dist\*' -Destination '..\android\app\src\main\assets\' -Recurse -Force; Push-Location ..\android; $env:JAVA_HOME = 'C:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr'; $env:PATH = \"$env:JAVA_HOME\bin;$env:PATH\"; .\gradlew.bat assembleRelease assembleDebug; Pop-Location; Copy-Item '..\android\app\build\outputs\apk\release\app-release.apk' '..\geohub-app.apk' -Force; Copy-Item '..\android\app\build\outputs\apk\debug\app-debug.apk' '..\geohub-app-debug.apk' -Force; Write-Host 'APK generated at ../geohub-app.apk' -ForegroundColor Green"
